summary: Use a Bottom Nav to move between the top-level sections of an app from any screen.

useWhen.text: Move between the top-level sections of an app from any screen.

from.quote: Use a Bottom Nav to move between the top-level sections of an app from any screen.
Switch sections of the app

avoidWhen.text: More than five top-level destinations: with a sixth, items shrink to about 55 px and labels crowd each other.

from.quote: Items shrink to about 55 px and labels crowd each other.

anatomy.holds: White surface with a hairline top border (the guide shows it in Light).

from.quote: White surface with a hairline top border.

anatomy.holds: The destination people are on, in the accent colour.

from.quote: The destination people are on, in the accent colour.
Another destination, one tap away.

anatomy.holds: Names the destination in one or two words.

from.quote: Names the destination in one or two words.
always at the bottom

placementAdvice.text: Bottom Nav spans its screen and anchors to the bottom edge.

from.quote: Bottom Nav spans its screen and anchors to the bottom edge.

placementAdvice.text: It anchors itself to the bottom of its nearest positioned container.

from.quote: anchors itself to the bottom of its nearest positioned container

placementAdvice.text: Its height comes from the items and the padding, 78 px in the installed package.

from.quote: Its height comes from the items and the padding, 78 px in the installed package.

configuration.text: Three to five destinations, exactly one Active.

from.quote: Three to five destinations, exactly one Active

configuration.text: Every destination gets an equal share of the bar.

from.quote: Every destination gets an equal share of the bar.

configuration.text: Fewer destinations mean wider tap targets; five is the most that stays comfortable.

from.quote: Fewer destinations mean wider tap targets; five is the most that stays comfortable.

configuration.text: The screen tells Bottom Nav which destination is Active through its value.

from.quote: The screen tells Bottom Nav which destination is Active through its value.

configuration.text: Bottom Nav sets each item's BottomNavItem / State mode from value: the item whose value matches is Active, the rest Idle.

from.quote: Bottom Nav sets each item’s BottomNavItem / State mode from value

configuration.text: The app keeps the Active value and swaps the screen above when it changes.

from.quote: The app keeps the Active value and swaps the screen above when it changes.

configuration.text: Bottom Nav only reports which destination was pressed: onChange receives that destination's value.

from.quote: Bottom Nav only reports which destination was pressed.

configuration.text: A destination can be disabled while it is temporarily unavailable: set disabled on its BottomNav.Item.

from.quote: A destination can be disabled while it is temporarily unavailable.

configuration.text: Don't leave nothing Active: with no match for the value, every item looks Idle.

from.quote: With no match for the value, every item looks Idle.

rules.text: One or two words per destination.

from.quote: One or two words per destination

rules.text: Use short nouns people already know, each with an icon that matches it.

from.quote: Use short nouns people already know, each with an icon that matches it.

rules.text: Don't use a long label: it wraps and makes that item taller than the rest.

from.quote: A long label wraps and makes that item taller than the rest.

rules.text: Give each destination its own icon: icons help people find a section at a glance.

from.quote: Icons help people find a section at a glance.

rules.text: Don't reuse one icon everywhere: identical icons force people to read every label.

from.quote: Identical icons force people to read every label.

states.when: The destination whose value matches Bottom Nav's value: only the matching item switches to Active.

from.quote: Only the matching item switches to Active.

states.when: Every other destination: one Active, the rest Idle.

from.quote: One Active, the rest Idle

states.when: A destination that is temporarily unavailable: dimmed and skipped by keyboard focus.

from.quote: Dimmed and skipped by keyboard focus.

accessibility.text: Each destination is a tab named by its label.

from.quote: each item `role=tab`, `aria-label` = label

accessibility.text: Don't rely on accessibilityLabel or on the Active state being announced on the web: the tab list has no accessible name, even with accessibilityLabel, and the Active tab is not exposed as selected.

from.quote: On the web the tab list has no accessible name, even with accessibilityLabel, and the Active tab is not exposed as selected.

doDont.why: Items shrink to about 55 px and labels crowd each other.

from.quote: Keep three to five destinations

doDont.why: With no match for the value, every item looks Idle.

from.quote: Keep one destination Active

doDont.do: Give each destination its own icon
doDont.why: Identical icons force people to read every label.

from.quote: Give each destination its own icon

examples.purpose: Switching sections of the app, the guide's In context: a Screen holds the Active section's content and the Bottom Nav, which anchors to its bottom edge. Five destinations, each a short noun with its own icon; Home is Active. The app keeps the Active value and swaps the content above when onChange reports a pressed destination: the literal value and the empty onChange stand for the app's own state.
examples.jsx:
<Screen>
  <VStack>
    <Text text="Home" />
    <Text text="Your balances and recent activity" />
  </VStack>
  <BottomNav value="home" onChange={(value) => {}}>
    <BottomNav.Item value="home" label="Home" iconName="ic_home" />
    <BottomNav.Item value="finances" label="Finances" iconName="ic_rupee" />
    <BottomNav.Item value="pay" label="Pay" iconName="ic_scan_qr_code" />
    <BottomNav.Item value="invest" label="Invest" iconName="ic_rupee_coin" />
    <BottomNav.Item value="explore" label="Explore" iconName="ic_search" />
  </BottomNav>
</Screen>

from.quote: The app keeps the Active value and swaps the screen above when it changes.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of the currently selected item.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired when an item is pressed.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the component (BottomNav.Item components).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accepted by the type but discarded: the tab list gets no name from it.

props.name: ...Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof View>, 'style' | 'accessibilityRole' | 'accessibilityLabel' | 'accessibilityHint'>
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

props.name: BottomNav.Item
props.description: Each destination is a BottomNav.Item with value, label, iconName, disabled and onPress. Declared: A static sub-component of BottomNav. Its own props: value.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection BottomNav reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: children
slots.description: The content of the component (BottomNav.Item components).

events.name: onChange
events.description: Callback fired when an item is pressed.

gaps.text: Figma draws the bar at 77 px; the package renders 78 px, with its 1 px top border inside the bar.
